value.rationale: The right spherical lune is the canonical two-hemisphere intersection studied in spherical convex geometry. The complete explicit law of its Haar great-circle section length, not merely a moment, has a striking logarithmic central singularity, exact quantiles and sharp local concentration; these quantify isotropic section statistics usable in random cutting and sampling calculations. It is not a normalization or renaming of a listed result.
